newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai banks to release bad loan figures Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Thai banks to release bad loan figures Thursday.

text.p: Somchai Sakunsurarat, president of Bank of Ayudhya Plc, said most Thai commercial banks were expected to announce their non-performing loan figures through the Stock Exchange of Thailand on Thursday.

A senior central bank official partly attributed the baht's decline to a record low on Wednesday to market jitters over growing doubtful loans of commercial banks which have posted weak earnings this week.
Most Thai banks have released first-half earnings 10 to 50 percent lower than a year ago.
The Thursday schedule of releasing bank non-performing loans has not been confirmed by other bankers.
